create_model_card_from_template: create a ModelCard from a template with ModelCardData including language, license, and tags
load_repo_card_from_hub: load a RepoCard from a Hugging Face Hub repository README.md or a local file path
push_card_to_hub: push a RepoCard to a Hugging Face Hub repository with commit message and optional PR creation
update_repo_metadata: update metadata in a repository README.md on the Hugging Face Hub with merge or overwrite logic
create_eval_result_metadata: create a metadata dict containing model evaluation results on a dataset with metrics and task info
